body: Diagnostic substrate (this session). False-veto sweep over eval/gittables/corpus_pass/columns.parquet, agreement columns (sense==ydf==X) as the 'truly X' proxy, per-label cap 3000, via scripts/apply_ydf_validation_gate.py load_validations()+evaluate(). Of 78 measurable typed validations: 40 clean (<2% veto), 23 at >=10%. TRIAGE — Group 1 too-strict (FIX, ac-01/02/03): timestamp.mdy_12h 98% (no :SS), timestamp.rfc_3339 94% (offset needs colon), time.iso 88% (frac must be 6 digits), time.hms_24h 36% (no frac allowed), component.year 23% (^\\d{4}$ rejects 1998.0), gender enum 22% (case), day_of_week enum 70% (case), continent enum 60% (mostly genuine mislabels+codes, case recovers only 7pp). Group 2 gate-working-correctly (LEAVE): government.ein 100% (77105464-1 not XX-XXXXXXX), commerce.isbn 39% (values are DOIs), banking.aba_routing 35% (10 digits not 9), time.hm_24h 45% ('304;1' junk), country_code 15% (JUS not ISO). Case-fold audit (13 enums): recovers day_of_week 51pp, gender 17pp, continent 7pp; booleans+country_code unchanged. 152 of 230 typed validations UNMEASURABLE (<30 agreement cols) — same rare-type starvation as spec 2026-06-04. See memory validation-gate-asymmetry.

Taxonomy follow-up (deferred from ac-01): seconds-bearing mdy_12h. The sweep's 98% false-veto on datetime.timestamp.mdy_12h is the form '06/30/2013 12:00:00 AM' (HH:MM:SS AM). Its format_string '%m/%d/%Y %I:%M %p' has no %S and strptime has no optional-seconds — so a seconds-bearing mdy_12h is a DISTINCT canonical format, not a regex widening. Needs a taxonomy decision (new type datetime.timestamp.mdy_12h_seconds, or a normalisation step), tracked separately. Same logic applies to any other format whose round-trip transform can't absorb the widened pattern — widen pattern only where format_string/transform round-trips.
